description_target.target_text: Split the input into four panels. Infer the transform that maps panel A to panel B, and the transform that maps panel B to panel C. Compose those two transforms in that order and apply the resulting two-step transform chain to the query panel.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Row of four n-x-n panels (1-col gaps): A B C D, where B = t1(A) and
 ;; C = t2(B) for dihedral transforms t1/t2. Read both transforms off the
 ;; demonstrations, then replay them in order on the query: answer = t2(t1(D)).
 (let ()
   (define transforms
     (list (cons 'id (lambda (x) x))
           (cons 'rot90 rotate-cw)
           (cons 'rot180 rotate-180)
           (cons 'rot270 rotate-ccw)
           (cons 'flip-h flip-lr)
           (cons 'flip-v flip-ud)
           (cons 'transpose transpose)
           (cons 'anti-transpose (lambda (x) (rotate-180 (transpose x))))))
   (define (panel i)
     (let* ((pw (quotient (- w 3) 4))
            (left (* i (+ pw 1))))
       (subgrid g 0 left (- h 1) (+ left pw -1))))
   (define (infer a b)
     (cdr (find-first (lambda (t) (equal? ((cdr t) a) b)) transforms)))
   (let ((t1 (infer (panel 0) (panel 1)))
         (t2 (infer (panel 1) (panel 2))))
     (t2 (t1 (panel 3))))))
